summary.text: Profound jade snake cave is a top Central Continent resource point held by Heaven's Envy Manor, home to profound jade snakes, immemorial desolate beasts that counter poison.

claims.text: Profound jade snake cave is a famous super resource point in Central Continent, and it belongs to Heaven’s Envy Manor, one of the ten great ancient sects. The cave’s annual resource production is among Central Continent’s top five, and its resources run to many types, among them enslavement path, transformation path, earth path, dark path, space path, and poison path.

The cave is a breeding ground for countless poisonous creatures, and its overlords are profound jade snakes, immemorial desolate beasts that counter poison; every one is born from jade, scaleless, light green like jade, and fresh-scented. The snakes are the cave’s most valuable resource, but its terrain of thousands of nested caves, swollen large by space path dao marks, makes the small, quiet snakes hard to find. Heaven’s Envy Manor possesses this super resource point and has set up an immortal formation there, yet has never grasped the cave completely, sending many Gu Immortal experts every year to capture the snakes.
Fang Yuan uses a killer move to lift the whole cave from the ground and shrink it into his sovereign immortal aperture, the eleventh super resource point he has taken.
